ignoreValues.reason: Claude decided: tried transform-only (scaleX on a 1px box) first; CSS clamps overlapping corner-radii against the element's own untransformed width before any transform applies, so the 1px box's border-radius collapsed to ~0 and rendered as a rectangle (confirmed via zoomed pixel screenshot, not just computed style). Reverted to animating real width. Element is position:absolute (isolated from document flow, can't cascade into reflowing surrounding content) and only changes on ~4 discrete hover events, not continuously.
